about.title: What is Mandalart?
about.description1: Mandalart is a goal achievement tool developed by Japanese designer Hiroaki Imaizumi.
about.description2: Major League Baseball player Shohei Ohtani is famous for systematically managing his goals using Mandalart during his high school years.
about.step1: Write your goal in the center
about.step2: Write 8 key elements to achieve the goal in surrounding cells
about.step3: Write specific action plans for each element
about.step4: Track progress and achieve your goal
about.mini_description: This app provides a 3x3 mini Mandalart format. Place your core goal in the center and write sub-goals in the surrounding 8 cells to achieve it. You can manage your goals in a simple and focused manner.
